tests.assertion: test('4872拒赦真实必暴、伤害翻倍且以混沌结算，怀生光结算不改技能原类型',()=>{for(const form of['pale','wrath']){const a=make({move:10629,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10629,20044,38273,29270,38275]}),b=make({move:10629,index:-1});a.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form=form;a.fighters[1].type=b.fighters[1].type='光';let observed;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){observed={affinity:c.affinity,stab:c.stab,modifier:c.modifier,crit:c.crit};if(form==='pale')c.a.soulId=null;}},()=>turn(a));turn(b);assert.equal(a.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].type,'光');assert.equal(observed.affinity,E.typeEffectiveness(form==='pale'?'光':'混沌','光',a.typeChart));assert.equal(observed.stab,E.sameTypeBonus(form==='pale'?'光':'混沌',a.fighters[0].type,a.typeChart));assert.equal(observed.crit,form==='wrath');if(form==='wrath'){assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*3.5);}}});

tests.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

tests.name: 4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖
tests.assertion: test('4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖',()=>{for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆']){let changed=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;for(const s of[a,b]){s.criticals=name==='会心'||name==='免爆';if(name==='精准'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-1;}if(name==='回避')delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];}const crit=[];for(const s of[a,b]){let val;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===(name==='免爆'?1:0))val=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,name==='免爆'||name==='回避'?10127:20117));crit.push(val);}if(name==='精准'||name==='回避'){const side=name==='精准'?0:1,ar=sum(a,'attack',side)>0,br=sum(b,'attack',side)>0;if(name==='精准')assert.ok(!br||ar);else assert.ok(!ar||br);if(ar!==br)changed++;}else{if(name==='会心')assert.ok(!crit[1]||crit[0]);else assert.ok(!crit[0]||crit[1]);if(crit[0]!==crit[1])changed++;}}assert.ok(changed>0,name);}const a=copyBattle('免爆',{kind:'status'});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===1)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(a,20044,10127));assert.equal(crit,true);});
